definitions.explanation: A fee paid once per year to maintain membership in an organization, use of a credit card, or access to a service.

examples.japanese: このクレジットカードは{年会費|ねんかいひ}{無料|むりょう}です。
examples.english: This credit card has no annual fee.

examples.japanese: {年会費|ねんかいひ}が{高|たか}いので{解約|かいやく}した。
examples.english: I cancelled because the annual fee was too high.

examples.japanese: {年会費|ねんかいひ}を{払|はら}えば{特典|とくてん}が{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: You can receive benefits if you pay the annual fee.

examples.japanese: {初年度|しょねんど}{年会費|ねんかいひ}{無料|むりょう}のキャンペーン{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: We are running a campaign with the first year's annual fee waived.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {年|ねん} (year) + {会費|かいひ} (membership fee). Literally "yearly membership fee."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{年会費|ねんかいひ}{無料|むりょう} (no annual fee)
・{年会費|ねんかいひ}が{発生|はっせい}する (annual fee is charged)
・{年会費|ねんかいひ}を{支払|しはら}う (to pay the annual fee)
・{初年度|しょねんど}{年会費|ねんかいひ}{無料|むりょう} (first year annual fee free)
・{年会費|ねんかいひ}{永年|えいねん}{無料|むりょう} (annual fee free forever)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・クレジットカード (credit cards)
・{会員|かいいん}サービス (membership services)
・スポーツジム (sports gyms)
・{会員制|かいいんせい}クラブ (membership clubs)
・{資格|しかく}{維持|いじ} (professional certification maintenance)

RELATED TERMS:
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん} - enrollment fee, joining fee
・{月会費|げっかいひ} - monthly membership fee
・{会費|かいひ} - membership fee (general)
